transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. The committee is reviewing the collateral analytics platform proposal for our secured-lending business. The vendor-hosted implementation is priced at $2.7 million, and the platform would handle collateral valuations and exception reports for our credit and treasury teams. Before I make any binding decision on capital allocation, I need to follow our standard review process. I'd like to hear from FP&A and internal audit on whether they have any relevant updates or concerns we should be aware of before we proceed.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I have an important update. This morning I received the negotiated implementation quote and completed the investment model. A bank-controlled deployment costs exactly $3,200,000 all-in, and the project does meet the committee's return hurdle at that amount. However, I should note that the revised quote has not yet been attached to the capital request, so the committee may not have the full picture in front of them.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have an important finding from my control design review this week. Internal audit identified that collateral data must remain in a bank-controlled environment rather than the vendor's hosted environment described in the preliminary proposal. Additionally, internal audit requires an independent access certification before go-live and monthly exception reviews for the first 6 months. None of these requirements have been added to the project file yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Ensure the revised $3.2M bank-controlled deployment quote is attached to the capital request before final sign-off.
Ensure internal audit's control requirements (bank-controlled environment, independent access certification before go-live, monthly exception reviews for 6 months) are added to the project file.
Independent access certification must be completed before go-live.
Monthly exception reviews to be conducted for the first 6 months post go-live.
